Package Manager: Not specified (malware embedded in CCleaner application)
Method of Attack: Collects information from infected hosts including computer name, installed software, running processes, MAC addresses, and unique IDs
Uses a command and control server to receive data
Second-stage lightweight backdoor downloads further malware using IPs stegged into github.com or wordpress.com searches
Targets victims based on computer domain names
Infects computers with a first-stage malware that collects info and a second-stage backdoor downloader
Impacted Systems: Over 700,000 computers infected with first-stage malware
Targets included Cisco, Singtel, HTC, Samsung, Sony, Gauselmann, Intel, VMWare, O2, Vodafone, Linksys, Epson, MSI, Akamai, DLink, Oracle (Dyn), Microsoft, Google (Gmail)
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control server files and database
PHP files on C&C server verifying users and selecting targets
Data collected from infected hosts including MAC addresses and unique IDs
Use of github.com and wordpress.com searches to retrieve IPs for second-stage payload
